summary: Retest of iteration_13 CRITICAL bugs for /editor text overlay. Both fixes verified end-to-end via Playwright with real page.mouse events. FIX1 (mouse click on text-commit/text-cancel): overlay now closes on real mouse click; commit renders text to canvas (1366 non-bg pixels found near click point) and cancel leaves canvas byte-identical (dataURL length 4114514 before and after). FIX2 (live font/size/color preview while overlay open): changing text-font-select to Impact updates text-input computed fontFamily to 'Impact, "Arial Black", sans-serif'; switching to Serif (Georgia) updates to 'Georgia, serif'; slider->90 updates computed fontSize to 90px; clicking swatch-1 (rgb(106,166,255)) instantly updates text-input color to rgb(106,166,255). Drag continues to work (overlay left/top style changed from left:50%/top:44.375% to left:64.06%/top:49.375% after +150/+80 mouse drag on text-drag-handle). Commit-with-latest-style test: after selecting Impact/size 80/swatch-2 (rgb(201,242,105)) then typing FINAL and mouse-clicking Add, canvas showed ~5375 pixels matching swatch-2 color and 'FINAL' rendered visibly (see screenshot). Both critical iteration_13 bugs are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: One minor flaky observation: immediately after a drag+release of the overlay, the very next real mouse click on [data-testid=text-commit] occasionally did not close the overlay in the same tick (observed once during the DRAG+commit combined test; a subsequent open+commit worked fine). Likely a lingering captured-pointer race on the drag-handle where pointerup->click sequence overlaps with the immediately-following mouse.click on the commit button. Non-blocking, but worth a small guard: on pointerup in startTextDrag ensure releasePointerCapture is called BEFORE the window listeners are removed, and consider clearing textDragRef.current synchronously before releasing capture. Standalone commit/cancel via mouse works reliably.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the requested retest checks (FIX1 commit-by-click, FIX1 cancel-by-click, FIX2 live font, FIX2 live size, FIX2 live color, drag-still-works, commit-with-latest-style all PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_13 CRITICAL bugs fixed in Editor.jsx. Parent .text-overlay div no longer has onPointerDown; drag handlers are bound only to .text-drag-bar and pointercapture is applied to the overlay via closest() so drag off-handle still tracks via window-level pointermove/pointerup listeners. Overlay input style now reads top-level color/textFont/textSize directly, and commitText also uses root state (not the activeText snapshot). Verified live-updates + real mouse click commit/cancel + drag + commit-with-latest-style. Minor: after a drag, an immediate follow-up mouse click on text-commit was flaky once; standalone click on commit/cancel is 100% reliable. No further action required from main agent unless they want to tighten the drag-release ordering.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — bugs from iteration_13 are fixed and reverified.
